### 1.  A convenient change of variables  

Put  

\[
u=2x ,\qquad Y=2y .
\]

Then  

\[
\begin{aligned}
4x^{3}-3x-1&=2y^{2}\\[2mm]
\Longrightarrow\; 
u^{3}-3u-2&=4y^{2}=Y^{2}.
\end{aligned}
\]

Hence  

\[
Y^{2}=u^{3}-3u-2.
\tag{1}
\]

---

### 2.  Factor the cubic  

\[
u^{3}-3u-2=(u-2)(u+1)^{2},
\]

so (1) becomes  

\[
Y^{2}=(u+1)^{2}(u-2).
\tag{2}
\]

Because the right–hand side is a perfect square, the factor \((u+1)^{2}\) must
divide \(Y^{2}\); consequently \(u+1\mid Y\).
Write  

\[
Y=t\,(u+1)\qquad(t\in\mathbb Z).
\]

Substituting this in (2) gives  

\[
t^{2}(u+1)^{2}=(u+1)^{2}(u-2)\;\Longrightarrow\;t^{2}=u-2 .
\]

Thus  

\[
u=t^{2}+2,\qquad 
Y=t\,(u+1)=t\,(t^{2}+3).
\tag{3}
\]

---

### 3.  Return to \((x,y)\)

Recall \(u=2x\) and \(Y=2y\).
From (3)

\[
2x=t^{2}+2,\qquad
2y=t\,(t^{2}+3).
\tag{4}
\]

For \(x,y\) to be integers the right–hand sides of (4) must be even.
Hence \(t^{2}\) is even, i.e. \(t\) is even.  Write \(t=2k\) with
\(k\in\mathbb Z_{>0}\).  Then (4) becomes

\[
x=\frac{(2k)^{2}+2}{2}=2k^{2}+1,\qquad
y=\frac{2k\bigl[(2k)^{2}+3\bigr]}{2}=4k^{3}+3k .
\]

---

### 4.  Verification  

Insert \(x=2k^{2}+1,\;y=4k^{3}+3k\) into the original equation:

\[
\begin{aligned}
4x^{3}-3x-1
&=4(2k^{2}+1)^{3}-3(2k^{2}+1)-1\\
&=2\bigl(4k^{3}+3k\bigr)^{2}=2y^{2},
\end{aligned}
\]

so every pair of this form indeed satisfies the equation.

Conversely, the deductions above are reversible:
any integer solution of \(4x^{3}-3x-1=2y^{2}\) forces
\(u=2x\) and \(Y=2y\) to satisfy (2), which forces
\(u+1\mid Y\) and consequently \(u=t^{2}+2,\;Y=t(t^{2}+3)\) with even
\(t\).  Hence every positive integer solution arises from the
parameter \(k=t/2\).

---

### 5.  All positive integer solutions  

\[
\boxed{\;(x,y)=(\,2k^{2}+1,\;4k^{3}+3k\,)\qquad(k=1,2,3,\dots)\;}
\]

The first few solutions are  

\[
(3,7),\;(9,38),\;(19,117),\;(33,268),\;(51,515),\dots
\]

(For \(k=0\) we obtain the trivial solution \((x,y)=(1,0)\), which is
excluded because \(y\) must be positive.)  Hence the above parametrisation
gives **all** positive integer solutions of the equation.<|eot_id|> <|end_of_text|>
